description.narrative: The Rwanda Standards Board’s (RSB) facilities are used to enforce conformity to industrial goods standards. During the first phase of the project, RSBs capacity has been built to increase its ability to enforce competence through accreditation to offer HACCP and ISO 22000 certification. The Rwanda Quality and Standards project is aimed at developing and implementing interventions to address technical barriers to trade in industrial and agricultural goods with interventions tailored towards improving services provided by the relevant Government of Rwanda conformity assessment bodies
